subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Explore all avenues

options.text: Try out every possibility to get a result

solution:
The correct answer is **"Try out every possibility to get a result."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Explore all avenues"** means to exhaust all possible options or solutions to a problem. (किसी समस्या के सभी संभावित विकल्पों या समाधानों को समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I want you to **explore all avenues**__ before mounting an attack on the enemy.*
 
 
 
• The idiom emphasizes the importance of considering every possible approach before giving up.
 
• The word** "avenue" **refers to a path or route, so exploring all avenues means exploring all possible paths to a solution. (चौड़ी सड़क जिसके दोनों ओर पेड़ या ऊँची इमारतें हों)
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

185:T5db,
The correct answer is **"To make a lot of effort without achieving anything."**
